pages.title: A modular display
pages.text: Make a Holographic Display Base with its reusable blueprint in a Constructor or Auto Constructor. Place bases side by side at the same level and facing to share a vertical surface.$(br2)Right-click any base to set a common height of 1–10 blocks. Displays need no power or cables.$(br2)Power, Storage and Text modules also have Constructor blueprints. Click or drag a slider; its outer arrows adjust by one.

pages.title: Surface settings
pages.text: Cycle the surface between Invisible, Transparent and Solid. $(thing)Color...$() shows a color preview and opens a hue/shade picker. Choose a shade or press its x to return.$(br2)Transparent mode adds a 0–100% transparency slider: 0% is opaque and 100% fully clear. The default is 87%. Color and transparency are remembered between modes.$(br2)Border is independent and on by default, even on invisible backgrounds. All settings apply to joined bases; older saved presets retain their appearance.

pages.title: Installing modules
pages.text: Right-click a held module to configure it. Sneak-right-click a suitable machine or inventory to link; do this in the air to clear the link.$(br2)Aim at the front of the display. A green rectangle fits; red means overlap or insufficient room. Right-click to install.$(br2)Press and release right-click on an installed module without dragging to edit it, even with empty hands. Sneak-right-click it to recover its configured item. Links and settings stay with recovered modules.

pages.title: Moving modules
pages.text: Hold right-click on an installed module and aim to drag it. You can move across joins between bases on the same screen. The outline is green when it fits and red when it overlaps or leaves the surface.$(br2)Release to place it. An illegal drop snaps back to its original position. Dragging never opens settings on release, even after returning to the starting point. Settings and machine links stay with the module.

pages.title: Power readings
pages.text: Sneak-right-click an Ariente generator, tank, cable or powered machine with a Power module to link it.$(br2)Choose Numbers, Meter or History, and toggle network flux, consumption per tick, generation per tick and fuel remaining. History covers the last 32 seconds of consumption and output.$(br2)Tanks report their generator’s network. Flux is a continuing supply, not a stored battery charge. Unsupported readings show $(thing)n/a$().

pages.title: Storage counts
pages.text: Sneak-right-click an inventory with a Storage module. The clicked side determines which inventory access it reads.$(br2)$(thing)Most stored$() lists up to 16 item types. $(thing)Item grid$() offers 1–64 entries per page, 1–8 columns and a page selector. Larger layouts need more surface space.$(br2)Matching items and tags combine into totals. Readings refresh once per second near players. Unloaded targets stay unloaded and show an offline status; check the link and target if readings stop.

pages.title: Text and color
pages.text: Left-click the text area to type. Use normal arrow, Home/End, Backspace/Delete, selection and clipboard controls. Escape or clicking outside commits the edit and releases typing.$(br2)Adjust text size, or choose Color... to open a hue/shade picker. Selecting a shade or pressing its top-right x returns to settings.

pages.title: Changing the layout
pages.text: If an edit makes a module overlap another or outgrow the surface, it is returned with the new settings. A full inventory drops it nearby.$(br2)Shrinking the display is refused if installed modules would be cut off. Move or recover those modules first. Breaking a base returns modules that lose their supporting surface.$(br2)Invisible backgrounds still accept modules and clicks. Power and Storage modules only report readings; they do not transfer items or control machines.
